## Mood Categories

- **cry-it-out** — K-dramas with emotional, tearjerking stories | https://dramamatch.app/mood/cry-it-out
- **feel-good** — Warm, uplifting K-dramas | https://dramamatch.app/mood/feel-good
- **edge-of-seat** — Thriller and suspense K-dramas | https://dramamatch.app/mood/edge-of-seat
- **laugh-out-loud** — Comedy K-dramas | https://dramamatch.app/mood/laugh-out-loud
- **epic-romance** — Sweeping romantic K-dramas | https://dramamatch.app/mood/epic-romance
- **dark-twisted** — Dark, psychological K-dramas | https://dramamatch.app/mood/dark-twisted

## About the Matching Algorithm

DramaMatch uses weighted Jaccard similarity across 6 metadata dimensions:
1. **Genres** — Primary content classification (weight: 0.25)
2. **Themes** — Story themes (forbidden love, revenge, redemption, etc.) (weight: 0.25)
3. **Tropes** — Narrative tropes (enemies-to-lovers, slow burn, found family, etc.) (weight: 0.20)
4. **Tone** — Emotional register (dark, heartwarming, comedic, intense, etc.) (weight: 0.15)
5. **Setting** — Time period and location (historical, modern, fantasy realm, etc.) (weight: 0.10)
6. **Character Types** — Protagonist/antagonist archetypes (stoic lead, tsundere, villain lead, etc.) (weight: 0.05)
